The '''BR-47''' was a model of [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Ubrikki BR-47 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[May 4]], [[2015]] as part of the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer's Packs.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
